title: Mage-OS Workflow Definition
description: Step-graph definition consumed by the executor, form UI, canvas, and import/export. Version 4 adds the approval step (a human-decision gate parked on the wait spine, with on_approved / on_rejected / on_timeout edges and a required timeout); documents using it MUST declare schema 4. Version 3 adds the switch step (first-match-wins multi-way branch); documents using it MUST declare schema 3. Version 2 adds the wait step and the optional delay fields business_days / at; documents using them MUST declare schema 2 or later. Version 1, 2, and 3 documents remain valid. The optional top-level ui block is non-semantic (canvas layout persistence), legal at any schema version, never read by the engine, and preserved verbatim.

entry.description: Key of the first step; null only when steps is empty

ui.description: Non-semantic UI/canvas layout block, preserved verbatim by the engine and never evaluated. The only whitelisted non-semantic key; there is no general unknown-key passthrough.

action.description: Registered action code, e.g. order.add_comment. Static: never interpolated.

config.description: Action config. String values may contain {{ trigger.* }}, {{ steps.* }}, {{ workflow.* }}, {{ secrets.* }} placeholders (values only, never keys), optionally with whitelisted formatters, e.g. {{ trigger.grand_total|number:2 }}.

duration.description: ISO-8601 duration; absolute UTC arithmetic unless business_days/at are set

business_days.description: Schema 2 only. Day components count Mon-Fri in the store's timezone.

at.description: Schema 2 only. After the duration, roll forward to the next occurrence of this store-local time (24h HH:MM).

conditions_serialized.description: Rule condition tree, salesrule-compatible serialized format

revalidate_entity.description: true: re-hydrate the entity fresh before evaluating (correct default after delays); false: evaluate against the frozen trigger snapshot

waitStep.description: Schema 2 only. Parks the execution until the named trigger event fires for the same entity, or until the timeout elapses. The resume routes through on_event / on_timeout; the step's output exposes {resolution: 'event'|'timeout', event: <payload>} for downstream interpolation.

event.description: Trigger event name to wait for (matched against this execution's entity id)

timeout.description: Timeout after which on_timeout fires; ceiling-clamped by the max-delay guard

switchStep.description: Schema 3 only. First-match-wins multi-way branch: cases are evaluated top to bottom, the first whose condition tree matches is followed; the nullable default edge fires when no case matches. One shared revalidate_entity for the whole step (one hydration, evaluated N times). The step result records {matched: <case key>|null}.

key.description: Case label, unique within the step; recorded as {matched} in the step result

conditions_serialized.description: Rule condition tree, salesrule-compatible serialized format; empty/absent = always matches

revalidate_entity.description: true: re-hydrate the entity fresh before evaluating the cases (correct default after delays); false: evaluate against the frozen trigger snapshot

approvalStep.description: Schema 4 only. A human-decision gate parked on the wait spine: the execution parks (status waiting) with resume_at = now + timeout and an approval task is opened; a decision (admin UI or REST) or the timeout sweeper wakes it. Routes approved -> on_approved, rejected -> on_rejected, no decision -> on_timeout. The step output exposes {task_uuid} at park time and {resolution, note, payload, decided_by} after a decision (or {resolution:'timeout'}). Requires the MageOS_WorkflowsApprovals addon to save.

title.description: Request label, interpolated at park time; renders in the approvals grid and emails. May not contain {{ secrets.* }}.

instructions.description: Longer decision context, interpolated at park time. May not contain {{ secrets.* }}.

timeout.description: REQUIRED. Timeout after which on_timeout fires; ceiling-clamped by the max-delay guard. No indefinite parks.

assignee_role.description: Nullable role code the decision requires (matches a Magento authorization role); targeting + decide-time enforcement.

allow_bulk.description: Opt-in per gate: whether the approvals grid may bulk-decide this task. Incompatible with any required payload_fields entry.

payload_fields.description: Value form the decider fills in; keys are allowlisted into execution context. Absent = note-only.

key.description: Context output key, unique within the step

label.description: Form field label shown to the decider

type.description: Scalar type the decided value is coerced to

required.description: Enforced on approval only (never on reject/timeout)
